title: Persistent CUDA expert cache — correctness, effectiveness, budget

engine.binary_sha256_12: 3ad4cc047417 (v4.3 = v4 + sol-review hardening: offset-bound hits, exception-safe insert/evict, index ghost cleanup, map reserve, overflow guards, model-load-generation flush)
engine.design: fixed pre-allocated LRU arena keyed (layer<<32|expert), env DS4_CUDA_EXPERT_CACHE_GB (unset = bit-identical legacy behavior), fail-open, hits copy from arena (identical bytes to disk reads by construction: arena filled only from the streamed reads that produced output), O(1) eviction, stats breadcrumbs. Bounded by construction — no growth path (post-freeze invariant).
engine.sizing_basis: committed routing trace logs/g4a/: measured LRU curve predicted 74% hit @70 GiB; gate observed 73.7% (smoke) / 58.2% (mixed incl. 5K-prefill traffic) — simulation validated. Prefill claim corrected per audit: measured 19.2 t/s cold (5047/263.1 s) and 21.8 t/s warm-engine (G3 run D 232 s); earlier '~26' figure retracted.

harness: results/glm52-gates/harness/g4a_gate.sh under glm_safe_run.sh (kill-floor 15 GiB, fsync'd sampler); committed before execution

run_history.run1_fail: 08:00 — 2 fails: enabled-line asserted before lazy arena init (harness ordering bug), and warm reads 26% because the 5K long fixture ran BETWEEN repeats, evicting their working set. Fixes: assertion moved after requests; repeats measured before unrelated eviction pressure (choice documented in-harness); 72GB default.
run_history.run3_aborted: 10:02 started on v4.2, superseded mid-flight by v4.3 hardening; stopped deliberately (leftover server caused run4's collision)
run_history.run4_invalid: 10:09 collided with run3's zombie server ('another ds4 process is already running'); harness talked to the stale server — invalidated, box cleaned
run_history.run5_pass_FINAL: 10:30-11:04 on v4.3 (3ad4cc047417): 13/13 assertions PASS — warm 68.38 GB = 24% of uncached 274.79 GB, byte-identity all fixtures, quality TSVs identical, budget ok. THIS is the committed evidence.

assertions_summary.name: phaseA_cache_absent / phaseB_cache_enabled
assertions_summary.actual: off is really off; arena 7,398 slots x 9.28 MiB = 67.05 GiB

assertions_summary.name: byte_identical_short/long/short16 + repeat_stable
assertions_summary.actual: cache-on == cache-off byte-for-byte on every fixture (shaA==shaB incl. 5K-token long e433f3d53368); rep1==rep3

assertions_summary.name: warm_read_reduction (criterion revised at review per gate doc clause)
assertions_summary.expected: BOTH: (i) plain reading run2 < 65% of run1 (both cache-on; threshold derived from the committed routing-trace LRU curve: ~74% steady hit at this arena -> expected ratio ~0.61; run1 self-benefits from in-flight caching so 25% is unreachable under the plain reading by arithmetic, not by cache weakness) AND (ii) run2 < 25% of the UNCACHED baseline for the same fixture (absolute effectiveness)

assertions_summary.name: budget_adherence
assertions_summary.actual: 97 GiB total engine+cache while serving vs 117 GiB limit (arena fixed-size; saferun floor ~15 GiB never approached)

assertions_summary.name: quality_exits + quality_identical
assertions_summary.actual: score_official 3-vector NLL TSVs byte-identical cache-on vs cache-off

wall_times_s.note: wall times are from run 2 (08:07); run 5's equivalents (run.log): uncached short16 69 s, rep1 542 s, rep3 31 s — same shape

observations: End-to-end warm speedup 2.3x on repeats (70->30 s), 2.5x on the short fixture (99->39 s); long-prompt prefill barely helped (232->209 s) — chunk-union prefill already amortizes reads, so the cache's leverage is decode.
First cache-on request pays one-time arena warmup (~544 s incl. page-faulting 67 GiB): startup cost to engineer away later (prefault at load).

Steady mixed-traffic hit 58.2% at 67 GiB with 5K-prefill pollution; repeat-heavy traffic 73.7%. Next levers per research doc: kernel indirection into the arena (drop hit-path copies), MTP/drafting after residency, prefix disk-KV for TTFT.

trail: R1 FAIL: key lacked model binding; exception-unsafe insert/evict; operator[] in fill-failure cleanup; unchecked arithmetic -> fixed in v4.1/v4.2
R2 FAIL: offsets still insufficient for same-layout model reload; up_off unchecked -> v4.2 pointer-generation flush
R3 FAIL: pointer identity vulnerable to mmap address reuse -> v4.3 monotonic g_model_load_generation bumped at all three model-map registration entry points
R4 PASS: address-reuse closed, no bypass path, no new defect, rounds 2-3 items sound (reviewed excerpt committed as logs/g4a-gate/cache-implementation.txt)

evidence_review.round1: FAIL — (2) cache-OFF denominator ruled gate-weakening; (1) ancillary wall times were from run 2 not run 5; (4) '~26 warm prefill' and '6-12 projection' not established by timings. All addressed: dual-ratio criterion (61.4%<65% AND 24.9%<25%), run-5 walls noted, prefill figures corrected to measured values.

criterion_revision.trigger: sol evidence audit ruled the cache-OFF denominator alone was gate-weakening under the plain reading of 'run 2 < 25% of run 1'
criterion_revision.doc_basis: Part 4 G4a: 'threshold revisitable with sol at gate review'
criterion_revision.resolution: gate now requires BOTH the plain-reading ratio (revised threshold 65%, trace-arithmetic-justified) and the original 25% vs the uncached baseline; both computed from the already-committed run-5 raw deltas, both pass. Reordering repeats before the long fixture was ruled fair.
